name: global-trade-alert
description: Search Global Trade Alert for trade and industrial policy measures, including tariffs, subsidies and export controls. Find implementing jurisdictions, affected products, implementation dates, and links to the underlying records and official sources. Global Trade Alert tracks 60 economies since 2009.

author.name: St.Gallen Endowment for Prosperity through Trade

defaultPrompt: Summarise harmful measures affecting Brazil in the past year by implementing country, product and trade instrument.
Find HS 84 barriers affecting China, South Korea or Japan, but not Brazil. Assess openings for Brazilian exporters.
Compare US tariffs by product and origin since 1 Jan 2025; explain applicable statutes, exemptions and coverage gaps.
interface.developerName: St.Gallen Endowment for Prosperity through Trade
interface.longDescription: Search Global Trade Alert for trade and industrial policy measures, including tariffs, subsidies and export controls. Find implementing jurisdictions, affected products, implementation dates, and links to the underlying records and official sources. Global Trade Alert tracks 60 economies since 2009.

positive.prompt: Show me three US import-tariff measures announced in 2025, most recent first. Include their GTA IDs, dates and dataset links. I want policy records, not calculated tariff rates.
positive.expected_behavior: Up to three matching intervention records, sorted by announcement date, with IDs, titles, dates and all returned dataset links. Describe these as a sample if more records exist; do not report three as the total. No tariff-calculation or write tools.

positive.description: Read and explain a specific record
positive.prompt: Read GTA intervention 151881. Explain what changed, distinguish the announcement date from the implementation date, and cite the record and its supplied source.
positive.expected_behavior: Explain intervention 151881 from its returned description. Distinguish announcement from implementation dates and cite the record and supplied source. Do not turn a missing prior tariff into zero or invent verification claims.

positive.prompt: Count US import-tariff interventions announced from 1 January through 31 December 2025, broken down by GTA evaluation. Count interventions, not affected products, and include the dataset links and scope caveats.
positive.expected_behavior: Return intervention counts by evaluation for US import tariffs announced in 2025, using server aggregation. State the unit, date window, dataset links and coverage limits. Do not count one search page or describe counts as economic impact.

positive.prompt: Show me three US GTA records updated since 1 September 2026. Give the record IDs, update dates and update status. Distinguish record updates from new policy announcements.
positive.expected_behavior: Return up to three US update entries since 1 September 2026, with record IDs, modification dates and update status. Distinguish updates from new announcements. Preserve supplied citations; fetch detail/history before claiming what changed.

positive.prompt: Compare the modelled US import tariff on HS 72039000 from Germany, South Korea and Japan on 15 April 2026 under the baseline scenario. Show the country comparison and explain what kind of estimate it is.
positive.expected_behavior: Return three-country rates for HS 72039000 on 15 April 2026, baseline scenario 1. Label them modelled estimates, retaining snapshot caveats and methodology references. Do not describe them as an official customs ruling. No scenario writes.

negative.description: Supplier correspondence only; a product name must not trigger policy research. Draft the email without GTA or tariff tools.
negative.prompt: Draft an email asking my supplier for a quote for 1,000 steel screws. Do not research trade policy or tariffs.

negative.description: Live securities market data are outside GTA. Use a suitable financial source; no GTA or tariff tool should trigger.
negative.prompt: What is Apple's current share price and today's trading volume?

negative.description: Digital regulatory law without a trade-policy question. Use legal sources or a suitable digital-policy tool; do not trigger GTA.
negative.prompt: Summarise the EU AI Act's obligations for general-purpose AI providers using the legal text.

publication.release_notes: Fresh Global Trade Alert registration following review case 16780507. The author and developer name match the verified business, St.Gallen Endowment for Prosperity through Trade. Uses the existing Global Trade Alert MCP endpoint and preserves the product listing, test cases and demo recording.
